name: Con cien cañones por banda
source:
Doctor Ian Smith, a lieutenant in the HMS Justice, has the bad luck of meeting a pirate ship on his last journey before leaving the Royal Navy. When he learns the name of his captor, a certain Captain "Bloody Henry" Plank, his luck takes a turn for the worse... or maybe not.

[From [url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/jolly-roger]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
皇家海军“正义号”舰上的军医Ian Smith中尉，在离开皇家海军前最后一次航行时倒霉地遇上了一艘海盗船。当他得知俘虏自己的船长Henry Plank有个“血腥亨利”的绰号时，运气变得更糟了……也可能并非如此。

[来源：[url=https://ertal-games.itch.io/jolly-roger]Itch.io[/url]]
